name: MLC LLM
tagline: Universal machine learning compiler and local LLM runtime deploying models across GPUs, mobile, and web.
real_test_summary: Tested running compiled local chat models offline with an OpenAI-compatible REST server and CLI. Targets cross-platform hardware acceleration including Metal, Vulkan, and CUDA.
pros: Cross-platform runtime supporting CUDA, Metal, and Vulkan backends
Exposes a local OpenAI-compatible server for drop-in integration
Apache-2.0 open-source license with CLI and Python/REST interfaces
cons: Model compilation and prebuilt weights require matching runtime versions
Fewer one-click desktop chat polish features than dedicated GUIs
